prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Interactive Pet Selection Stage', 'Live Pet Fact Feed During Generation', 'Desktop Launch & Generation Activity Feed', 'Desktop Companion Control Preview Redesign']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Desktop Controls Interactive Guide', 'Account Restores & Sync Hint', 'Desktop Spawn Status & Diagnostics', 'Onboarding Roadmap Checklist', 'Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift', 'Spotlight Desktop Launch Focus', 'Photo Quality Assistant Hint', 'Reorder Sign-In After Friend Selection', 'Generation Activity Progress Status', 'Certificate Adoption Stage Layout', 'Companion Path Selection Tip', 'Pre-Generation Photo Verification Screen', 'Path Selector Card Layout Overhaul', 'Compact Quick Sign-In Interface', 'Interactive Pet Control Quick-Guide Screen', 'Real-Time Pet Assembly Progress & Desktop Launch Status']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Preset Pet Quick-Start Sub-Flow', 'Adoption Certificate Badge Reward', 'Split-View Companion Path Selector', 'Guided Pet Trait Customizer Flow', 'Starter Pet Bonus Badge', 'Account Sync & Multi-Device Warning Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Interactive Studio Redesign', 'Path Selection Carousel Redesign', 'Account Persistence & Pet Sync Safeguard Hint', 'Guided Pet Photo Calibration Sub-Flow', 'Desktop Companion Welcome & Shortcut Hub Redesign', 'Companion Journey Path Benefit Copy Focus']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because most categories have only a single test.
Adding a new screen at the finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt completion and had to be stopped early.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (5 tests) yielded two significant wins (+3.9% and +4.0% after noise correction), while three showed no clear effect.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Wait Visualizer
candidates.change: Displays an animated desktop companion loading visualizer with estimated spawn countdown on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has median 201s and mean 2336s wait time, and wait_info changes on home stage have previously yielded significant completion wins (+3.9% and +4.0%).

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Launch
waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready to land on your desktop screen.

candidates.title: Story Screen Hero Journey Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial story screen layout to a full_bleed video-backed hero layout to immerse users before path choice.
candidates.why: choose_path step conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration (514s), showing users stall early in onboarding.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Experience a living pet directly on your desktop.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a new sub-flow screen 'new_trait_selection' between photo upload and certificate adoption to let users define pet personality.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (66.2%) and users report custom pet creation issues.

new_trait_selection.headline: Choose Pet Personality
new_trait_selection.body: Select traits for your desktop companion.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit account persistence hint under sign-in options explaining how existing pets will stay connected.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your desktop pet and settings remain saved safely across sessions.

candidates.title: Two-Column Photo Upload Layout
candidates.change: Reorganizes the upload_photos screen into a two-column side-by-side view with live preview and photo guidelines.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for 3 support cases, and adoption stage drops to 66.2%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Clear front-facing photos yield the best desktop pet results.

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Preview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen 'new_archetype_preview' before choose_path to showcase animated pet archetypes.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion at choose_path indicates a dropoff before path commitment.

new_archetype_preview.headline: Meet the Companions
new_archetype_preview.body: Discover what your desktop companion can do.

candidates.title: Interactive Waiting Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Adds a rotating tip carousel component on the waiting screen explaining desktop interactions during generation.
candidates.why: Home wait step has median 201s / mean 2336s, and post-onboarding support (3 tickets) shows confusion over pet controls.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop to open quick controls.

candidates.title: Desktop Control & Visibility Intro Copy
candidates.change: Updates home_intro headline and body to explicitly explain how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 70.9% and support received multiple queries about hiding/talking to the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live!
home_intro.body: Click your pet on the desktop anytime to chat, hide, or access companion settings.

candidates.title: Interactive Friend Selection Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns pick_friend screen using a stage layout with animated pet interaction previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 66.2% conversion rate and takes median 89s / mean 1017s.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Base Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a desktop friend to start customizing.

candidates.title: Account Protection Sign-In Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a clear account status badge highlighting cloud save protection on the sign_in screen.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and users express confusion over missing pets after re-signing in.

components.text: Cloud Save Active: Keeps your pet safe across re-installs
